moodys.citation_text: Moody's dropped the rating two notches to Ba2 from Baa3 in September 2022, which represented ProMedica's loss of its last investment-grade rating.

sp.citation_text: S&P Global Ratings issued a multi-notch downgrade to ProMedica in August 2022, raising concerns with ProMedica's financial position.
sp.verification_note: Specific notch level not captured precisely from snippets; BB+ inferred from sequence and subsequent Fitch BB+ → BB- downgrade history.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch dropped already speculative-grade ProMedica two notches; sequence indicates BB+ entering 2023 (subsequently downgraded BB+ → BB- in May 2023).

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Moody's affirmed Ba2 rating with negative outlook in May 2023
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: ProMedica continued to face significant operational risks; combined operating cashflow expected to be minimal in fiscal 2023
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: In May 2023, Moody's affirmed its Ba2 rating with a negative outlook, reaffirming the Ba2 rating which is below investment grade.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Long-term IDR downgraded from BB+ to BB-; ratings placed on watch negative
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: $350 million in losses during Q4 2022; second Fitch downgrade since May 2022
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch downgraded ProMedica's Long-Term Issuer Default Rating in May 2023 from BB+ to BB-. The agency also downgraded $1.8 billion in bonds issued by various entities on behalf of ProMedica to the same grade, and placed its ratings on 'watch negative.'

moodys.citation_text: Moody's Ba2 negative outlook carried forward from May 2023 affirmation; no further rating action found through 2025-Q1.

sp.citation_text: S&P rating carried forward from 2022 downgrade; no subsequent rating action found in trade press through 2025-Q1.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch BB-/watch negative after May 2023 downgrade; subsequent updates not found in trade press through 2025-Q1.

outcome_class_rationale: Fitch downgraded BB+ to BB- in May 2023 — a two-notch single-action downgrade qualifies as MULTI_DOWNGRADE per schema. Moody's Ba2 negative was already in distressed speculative territory at window start; affirmation in May 2023 with negative outlook continued. Note: per pilot turnaround narrative, ProMedica's HCR ManorCare overhang and operating losses drove sustained sub-IG ratings.
